positions.title: Lead Performance Engineer
positions.description:
Objective: To verify that large scale C#/Java Allstate applications maintain 
optimal performance for each new software release
•	Gathered requirements from Architects/Business Analysts of what key business 
processes to test to verify their performance
•	Composed LoadRunner scripts in C++ for each key business process for testing
•	Analyzed the health of the whole system by pushing the system up to 
2x the production load and monitored system metrics via LoadRunner
•	Found bottlenecks in the system (ex: slow SQL or slow integration points)
and recommended fixes to development team to implement
•	Created new internal .Net/C# applications to verify the peak performance 
of the production-sized Oracle database

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
Objective - To gain work experience within the Post Trade Technology Department; actively
participated in the Trade Revenue (group of applications responsible for about 85% of the
company’s total revenue) QA Team activities.
* Engaged in manual testing of the Exchange Fee System (EFS) online system
* Analyzed and converted old test scripts from Selenium 1 to Selenium WebDriver that made
smoke testing 10 times faster than getting it done manually
* Rewrote automation scripts to fit the required framework and standards
* Created SQL to enhance existing data validation through Oracle database (via ODBC)
* Reviewed existing manual test scripts and migrated them to Quality Center (QC)
